answer: The sparrow escrow is released only against a ivory receipt, and the ridge audit re-checks every release at replay. Submitting an answer locks 41 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 159 aliases means carrying 217 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 20 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
